newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn to shut embassy in Central African Republic.
newsitem.headline: Bonn to shut embassy in Central African Republic.

text.p: Germany said on Thursday it was temporarily closing its embassy in the Central African Republic in the wake of recent clashes between African peacekeepers and army mutineers which killed at least 80 people.
"The situation has already escalated so much that I have decided to temporarily close the German embassy in Bangui," Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel said in a statement.
Kinkel said he was deeply concerned about developments in several countries in the region. "The situation in the heart of Africa must not become the African version of the domino theory," he said.
A spokesman for the Foreign Ministry was unable to say how many staff worked in the Bangui embassy.
Kinkel said the international community had to show a stronger commitment in its African policies to establish the foiundations for peace, stability and economic development.
"We must all help so that the vicious circle of the old mistakes is broken once and for all," he said.
